name: Addiction counselor and outpatient treatment

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Assessment
services.story: The main story: an assessment, then weekly visits. Nothing taken when booking; the plan is billed, and any share is paid at the front desk. The free screening call also runs here, with nothing to pay.

services.name: Assessment
services.story: A sliding-fee visit, or a share billed after the plan pays.

services.name: Individual visit
services.story: A self-pay visit: a card is saved, nothing is taken, and the visit is charged to the saved card when the counselor marks it DONE. A late-cancel fee applies only if it was agreed at booking and the owner confirms.

services.name: Court-ordered class series
services.story: A court-ordered education class series, $250, paid in full when booking. Nothing more is charged after it.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: David (counselor) and Elena (associate counselor under supervision)
B.customer: Alex M. (client, who can't travel for now) · other clients

services.name: Home-based visit
services.story: The main story: a home-based visit with David, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am. Nothing is taken; the plan is billed, and any share is texted as a bill after the visit.

services.name: Home-based visit
services.story: The same visit for a publicly funded client: nothing is taken and no card is saved; the program bills the public funder its own way.

services.name: Home-based visit
services.story: A self-pay home visit: a card is saved, and the visit is charged to it at DONE. A late-cancel fee applies only if agreed at booking and the owner confirms.

services_shape: clinic: a client books one counselor's time for an assessment and individual visits, and a seat in group visits on a timetable (intensive outpatient is a set group several days a week for weeks); care runs as a plan of many weeks; some clients come because a court, an employer or a licensing board requires it
questions_before_times: what it's for: a screening call, an assessment, a session, a group or intensive outpatient, a family session, a medication visit, or a court-ordered assessment or class
a health plan, self-pay (the sliding fee), or public funding (only the name here)
whether a court, a probation officer, an employer or a licensing board requires it (sets the kind of assessment; who it is and the papers go on the secure page)
for a group: which days work
the client's age (adolescent and adult groups are separate)
safety_stop: an overdose: not breathing, blue lips, won't wake up
dangerous withdrawal: a seizure, confusion, seeing things, shaking with a fever
harming someone else, or anyone in danger right now
first_steps: Screening read by a nurse or counselor
The plan check and any prior approval
license: the program's own word, optional: the program's state license or certification for outpatient substance use treatment, if it has one; each counselor's own credential or clinical license, as the owner gives it; a prescriber's license for medication visits. Rosie never looks a license up and never says one is checked
staff_skills: addiction counselor, clinical counselor or social worker, prescriber, adolescent groups, family sessions, intensive outpatient, approved court-ordered assessments and classes, home-based sessions, Spanish
messages_never: that the person is in addiction treatment, what is used, drug screen results, diagnoses, medicines, court or probation details, and money details never go in a text, a voicemail or an answer to another AI: only the secure page; texts use the program's plain display name (never 'recovery' or 'addiction'), the day, the time and the place
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
